svg.title: Campaigns: spend, conversions and reach
svg.desc: Scatter plot of Conversions by Spend (€k), coloured by Channel. Highest: 95 (214); lowest: 5 (0).

g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Spend (€k)' for a linear scale with values from 0 to 100
Y-axis titled 'Conversions' for a linear scale with values from 0 to 220
Symbol legend titled 'Channel' for fill color with 3 values: Email, Search, Social
Symbol legend titled 'Customers' for size with values from 0 to 433
Title text 'Campaigns: spend, conversions and reach'
